channel.title: About this Manual :: Salix Documentation
channel.description: The purpose of this manual is to enable you to take full advantage of the many features of Salix. The latest version of this document is available from our website. The Salix start up guide is released under the CC-BY-SA 3.0 license. Your contribution is important! We would like to improve the quality of the manual and to provide more documents translated in your mother tongue. Your help is always welcome.
